recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: three-decade protocols still stitching servers to the wider web
benchmark rooms asking whether silicon dice roll the same twice
spring evening stretching toward eight o'clock sunset over the bay
sixteen degrees and thin coastal air before the fog decides
stockholm-flavored playlists leaking through earbuds on california pavement

composer-2-fast.concept: You guard a vertical stutter-grid: colored pulses descend in Fred-again stagger; only taps on real beats score, phantom stutters punish.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Rhythm lane tap — four columns, pulses stack and speed; miss three phantoms and the run cracks.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Thumb alternates lanes with quick taps; long-press absorbs a stacked chord for bonus.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: One track is exactly 45 seconds; perfect chain explodes into a confetti waveform.
composer-2-fast.escalation: BPM creeps, ghost lanes blink, then a false drop swaps column order for two bars.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Neon waveform graffiti over black glass, pulses like spray-paint strokes.

gpt-5.5-high-fast.concept: Postcard airmail into wrong arrondissements: flick French-indie vignette cards into pastel slots before a paper metro door slams.
gpt-5.5-high-fast.mechanic: Flick-sort — cards arc from a stack; wrong slot adds wrinkle crumple that obscures the next target.
gpt-5.5-high-fast.touch_control: Single-finger flick angle and speed to choose slot.
gpt-5.5-high-fast.session_hook: Each cleared round adds a stamped window on a fold-out map.
gpt-5.5-high-fast.escalation: Doors slide faster; crumples stack until you must peel one with a two-tap pinch micro-gesture.
gpt-5.5-high-fast.aesthetic: Matte polaroid edges, muted pink and tram-rail gray.

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Dream-pop haze maze: drag a single glowing thread through drifting nodes; thread cannot cross itself, fog thickens toward the chorus drop.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: One-line path drawing through moving waypoints with a self-crossing ban.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: Drag to draw; release snaps the line if valid, else rewinds last segment.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Finishing before the ambient swell peaks unlocks a hidden bridge node.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Nodes orbit slowly, then blink out in dream-sequence order forcing replans.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Watercolor fog with silver pencil trace lines.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Tiny proxy gremlins carry packets across a scrolling rack; you reroute through glowing ports before latency slime climbs the spine.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Lane switch / gate flip — swipe racks sideways to align inbound blobs with outbound sockets.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Thumb swipe shifts entire rack layers left/right; tap toggles SSL shields that eat one spike.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Clearing a rack without slime touching copper clears the stage with a CRT bloom.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Adds multiplex ports that duplicate blobs unless you shield-split them first.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: Amber phosphor terminal glass over brushed aluminum chassis.
